第1375章 帝尊帝川（第1页）
“杀吾族魔神级别强者，便屠你人族所有圣王陪葬！”
话音落下，那一道魔神投影便是轰然绽放出极致浓郁的魔气，化作了无数的威压利爪朝着在场的每一位圣王强者杀去。
所过之处，魔气所迸发出的腐蚀毁灭气息甚至是将虚空直接湮灭出一个个深渊，法则溃散，天地元气当场紊乱不堪。
就在太华等圣王准备联手反抗之时。
一道儒雅带着淡淡低沉的声音缓缓响起：
“赤骸，这么多年不见，你还是这个脾气。”
“动不动就是要杀人，这习惯可是不太好。”
一道伟岸的法相虚影在这天幽州屹立而起，如同一道大日金光，熠熠生辉，散发着淡淡恐怖的无形帝威，虚影表面身上，仿佛是有着万千本源法则在流转，每一道法则都足以随意毁灭一州之地。
只见，他弹指间，一缕金光贯穿虚空，化作了一道屏障结界，尽数将赤骸殿主的杀招拦截了下来。
碰撞所产生的冲击波，当场便是将周围方圆数万里地尽数毁灭成虚无。
恐怖的波动，甚至是让太华等至强者都心惊不已。
“是你！！！？”赤骸看清来者之后瞳孔微眯，一抹阴沉的脸色浮现。
后者闻言，嘴角勾起一抹笑意，耸耸肩，轻声道：
“不要那么激动嘛，不就是陨落了一位魔神罢了，到了你这等层次的存在，难不成还会在意一个魔神的死活？”
“大不了，本帝尊给你一点补偿不就好了？”
“一株极品层次的先天灵宝，如何？”
现场的所有圣王包括魔神都是神色古怪，随后，炼狱圣王更是忍不住的笑出了声来。

帝川此话，分明就是在嘲讽玩弄赤骸。
要知道，别说是赤骸这等存在了，就算是寻常神桥境，对于一株极品层次的灵宝也不是特别大，这价值，甭说是换一位魔神强者了，就算是换一位神桥境都是完全不值当。
赤骇挥手间，滔天的魔气汇聚在利爪之上，贯穿虚空，朝着帝川狠狠撕裂而去。
所过之处，虚空直接留下了数道狰狞的爪痕！
见状，帝川也是丝毫不惧，反而是淡然从容道：
说完，帝川身上的圣王之力弥漫爆发，伴随着淡淡的帝意迸发，只见，他挥手间，便是轻松开辟出一方独立小世界，将赤骸吞噬进去。
即便是隔着一个独立小世界，太华等圣王强者都是能清晰的感受到传出的恐怖波动。
齐长风深深呼出一口气，嘴角掀起一抹弧度，淡淡道：
说完，齐长风身上的杀意冲天而起。
身影率先冲出，指尖圣王之力汇聚，一枚枚棋子落在天地棋盘之上，化作了无尽的镇压之力，轰然朝着贪寰杀去。
同时，点将台召唤出的六位圣王也是第一时间朝着贪寰杀去！
太华见状瞳孔一震，都还没有来得及说，便是见到齐长风又杀了出去，无奈的呼喊道：

"If you kill the powerful demon god of our race, I will kill all the saint kings of your race and bury him with him!"
As soon as the words fell, the demon projection burst out with extremely rich demonic energy, turning into countless coercive sharp claws and killing every powerful Saint King present.
Wherever it passed, the corrosive and destructive aura emitted by the demonic energy even directly annihilated the void into abyss, the laws collapsed, and the vitality of heaven and earth was in chaos on the spot.
Just when Taihua and other holy kings were preparing to join forces to resist.
An elegant and low-pitched voice slowly sounded:
"Chi Gu, I haven't seen you for so many years, and you still have the same temper."
"He always wants to kill people. This is not a good habit."
A majestic Dharma-like shadow stands in Youzhou on this day, shining like a golden sun, exuding a faint and terrifying invisible imperial power. On the surface of the shadow, it seems that there are thousands of original laws circulating on it, and each law is enough to destroy a state at will.
At the snap of his finger, a ray of golden light penetrated the void and turned into a barrier, intercepting all the killing moves of the Lord of Chishu Palace.
The shock wave generated by the collision destroyed everything around tens of thousands of miles into nothingness on the spot.
The terrifying fluctuations frightened even the most powerful people such as Taihua.
"Is it you!!!?" Chi Kui narrowed his pupils slightly after seeing the person clearly, and a gloomy expression appeared on his face.
Hearing this, the latter raised a smile on his lips, shrugged, and said softly:
"Don't be so excited. It's just that a demon god died. At your level of existence, is it possible that you still care about the life and death of a demon god?"
"The worst thing is, wouldn't it be nice if I, the Emperor, give you some compensation?"
"How about a top-level innate spiritual treasure?"
All the Holy Kings present, including the Demon God, looked strange, and then the Holy King of Purgatory couldn't help laughing.
Di Chuan's words were clearly mocking and toying with Chi Gu.
You know, let alone beings like Chi Skeleton, even an ordinary Shenqiao realm is not particularly valuable for a top-level spiritual treasure. This value, let alone a powerful demon god, is completely worthless even if it is a Shenqiao realm.
As Chi Hai waved his hand, monstrous demonic energy gathered on the sharp claws, penetrated the void, and fiercely tore towards Dichuan.
Wherever it passed, several ferocious claw marks were left directly in the void!
Seeing this, Dichuan was not afraid at all, but said calmly and calmly:
After saying that, the power of the Holy King in Dichuan's body exploded, accompanied by a faint burst of imperial will. With a wave of his hand, he easily opened up an independent small world and swallowed up the red skeleton.
Even across a small independent world, Taihua and other powerful Saint Kings could clearly feel the terrifying fluctuations coming from them.
Qi Changfeng took a deep breath, raised the corner of his mouth and said lightly:
After saying that, Qi Changfeng's murderous intent soared into the sky.
The figure rushed out first, the power of the Holy King gathered at the fingertips, and the chess pieces fell on the chessboard of heaven and earth, turning into endless suppressive power, and rushed towards Tan Huan.
At the same time, the six holy kings summoned by the Dianjiangtai also immediately went towards Tan Huan to kill him!
Taihua's pupils trembled when he saw this. Before he could say anything, he saw Qi Changfeng and killed him again, shouting helplessly:
